headline: Permane signs with Racing Bulls until 2031
body: Alan Permane stays as Racing Bulls team principal until the end of the 2031 season. The team has scored 108 points this year, up from 92 in 2025 and 46 in 2024, and is fighting for fifth in the constructors' championship.

headline: Piastri and Mark Webber end their management agreement
body: Oscar Piastri and the management team led by Mark and Ann Webber have agreed to end their contract. Webber has managed Piastri since 2019 and stepped back from a trackside role this season.
